answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Dawah & Tableeg Question ID: 3099 Country: Bangladesh Title: I would like to know about so-called Tabligh-Jamaat. Tabligh-Jamaat people claim, Dhikr of anything once while in Tabligh-Jamaat is equivalent to 49,0000000 (49 crore) times Dhikr in another time and the same thing about every other Good deeds like charity and etc. Is this valid according to Sunnah? Question: Assalamu-alaikum, I would like to know about so-called Tabligh-Jamaat. Tabligh-Jamaat people claim, Dhikr of anything once while in Tabligh-Jamaat is equivalent to 49,0000000 (49 crore) times Dhikr in another time and the same thing about every other Good deeds like charity and etc. Is this valid according to Sunnah? Allah Hafiz. Answer ID: 3099 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 259/193=H) What do you mean by ?so-called Tabligh-Jamaat? and what you would like to know about it? (2) This is right, Hazrat Maulana Mufti Muhammad Yusuf Shaheed Ludhianwi (who is a high profile scholar of the Quran and Hadith and all Islamic Sciences and at least it is not hidden from Muslims of Ahlus Sunnah ) has regarded this meaning correct in the light of hadiths . For details see his famous book: Aap ke masaail aur un ka hal , volume 7, page 286. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
